substitutions.official_or_paper: public encoders reject transpositions outside their 35 spelling and -7..7 key vocabularies

substitutions.official_or_paper: paper/public evaluation is primarily note/onset based

substitutions.official_or_paper: scientific specification requires a fixed equal budget but gives no integer

substitutions.official_or_paper: public run uses sampled subgraphs with batch 240 and subgraph size 500; the common protocol fixes update accounting but not a batch size
substitutions.reconstruction: one complete source/transposition graph per candidate update, with a seeded shuffled schedule and explicit applied/skipped accounting
